metricDefinition: Unique COMPOSITION FAMILIES / required visual-state specifications after deduplication. Each approved numerator entry is one exact approved branch variant, not a completed all-branch family. Remaining outfit/time/visible-prop variants are an additional work dimension, listed below; full all-branch render count is not established. This metric must not be advertised as all-branch completion or a generation/credit quote.
countingRule: One authored stable visual beat per registry ID, excluding the reserved journey; one documented contiguous hold group per listed anchor, not per line/speaker/menu visit or playthrough. Fades count as visual beats, not images. Hold IDs are documentation-only labels, not new runtime shots or story events. Count unique requirementId once; aliases/holds never add an image. 15 explicit plan hold rows plus 7 embedded dialogue/listening holds are enumerated.
